ov: نهاية شارع أوك (الإنجليزية: The End of Oak Street) هو فلم خيال علمي أمريكي صدر عام 2026، من كتابة وإنتاج وإخراج ديفيد روبرت ميتشيل، وبطولة آن هاثاواي وإيوان مكريغور ومايسي ستيلا وكريستيان كونفري. تم عرض الفلم في الولايات المتحدة في 14 أغسطس 2026، بواسطة وارنر برذرز بيكتشرز.
plotEn:
Set on July 10, 1982, Denise and Greg Platt live with their teenage children Audrey and Brian, and their dog Starbuck on Oak Street, in the suburban neighborhood of Flowervale, Michigan. The couple's marriage is strained—Denise, an aspiring novelist, privately contemplates divorce and resents Greg working a side job delivering pizza, lessening their family time.
The following day, Denise photographs a mysterious plant that suddenly appears in Mrs. Huddleston's yard. Local librarian Mrs. Valcourt identifies it as Pleuromeia, which went extinct 200 million years ago. A giant mound of animal feces appears in neighbor Mel's yard. Meanwhile, news broadcasts are reporting increased solar-flare activity. During a storm, a powerful white light suddenly engulfs the Flowervale neighborhood, accompanied by a change in atmospheric pressure and a power and water outage.
The next morning, Denise and Greg search for Starbuck, who went missing during the storm. They discover that a two-mile circle of Flowervale is now surrounded by a prehistoric landscape from which dinosaurs emerge and start hunting and killing neighborhood residents. Greg and Denise rush back home, chased by a vicious Coelophysis. The family boards up their windows and doors. Audrey theorizes that the light flashes were wormholes that transported the neighborhood millions of years into the past.
